projects.name: GPSTracker
projects.description: A GPS Tracking application that achieves free built-in way by Fused-location method to access location and share it to family via internet.

projects.name: MultiLangTranscriber
projects.description: A modular FastAPI system for multilingual video translation — extracts audio/frames, uses RAG-enhanced Whisper STT with visual context, refines transcription via LLM, translates with Google Translate, and reconstructs dubbed video. Supports local CPU & Google Colab GPU.

projects.name: TRACE
projects.description: TRACE is an offline-first browser productivity agent built with a Chrome MV3 extension and a local FastAPI backend. It silently watches your browser activity, infers intent, and surfaces pending task reminders at the right moment - without you ever needing to ask. All data lives in SQLite on your machine, with PII stripping baked in from day one.

projects.name: LANFXplorer
projects.description: QUIC protocol based P2P FileSharing app. Uses QUIC_API as backend. Can work in LAN/WIFI.
